claims.claimText: University of Limerick assessment guidance states that use of AI in an unauthorized manner is a breach of academic integrity, and that use not permitted by the module leader is a breach of academic integrity.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: The Academic Integrity Policy and the Procedures for Managing Allegations of Academic Misconduct, available on the UL Policy hub, indicate that it is a breach of academic integrity if AI is used in an unauthorised manner. coursework.en: The module leader or equivalent decides and communicates acceptable AI use. Use beyond those specifications is treated under the academic-misconduct framework.
coursework.zh: 模块负责人或同等角色决定并公布可接受的 AI 使用范围；超出规定的使用按学术不端框架处理。
coursework.meaningEn: Module or programme assessment conditions; institutional tool access does not override them.
coursework.meaningZh: 限模块或项目的考核条件，机构工具访问不覆盖这些规定。

exams.en: Check the exam’s stated authorised uses; the general module-leader rule does not establish a blanket permission for examinations.
exams.zh: 须核对考试规定的授权用途；模块负责人一般规则不构成全部考试的通用许可。
exams.meaningEn: Specific exam instructions and exceptions were not independently established.
exams.meaningZh: 具体考试说明和例外尚未独立核实。

disclosure.en: UL recommends acknowledging how GenAI was used in an assignment. A course, department or teacher may set additional task-specific requirements.
disclosure.zh: UL 建议在作业中说明如何使用生成式 AI；课程、院系或教师可能另设任务要求。
disclosure.meaningEn: The student tips say “recommended”; do not rewrite this as a universal mandatory disclosure rule.
disclosure.meaningZh: 学生提示原文为 recommended，不改写为全校统一强制披露。

privacy_data.en: Tool use must comply with UL’s Data Protection, IT Security and Acceptable Usage policies. This source set does not establish every permitted data category.
privacy_data.zh: 工具使用须遵守 UL 数据保护、IT 安全及可接受使用政策；本来源集合未核实所有可用数据类别。
privacy_data.meaningEn: Compliance framework; a named tool is not blanket approval for sensitive data.
privacy_data.meaningZh: 属于合规框架，工具被点名不等于敏感数据通用批准。

approved_tools.en: UL currently prefers Microsoft Copilot through staff or student accounts if GenAI is used. Individual activation and assessment permission remain separate.
approved_tools.zh: 若使用生成式 AI，UL 当前偏好师生通过大学账户使用 Microsoft Copilot；个人开通与考核许可须分别确认。
approved_tools.meaningEn: Preferred platform guidance; individual entitlement and costs were not verified.
approved_tools.meaningZh: 偏好平台指引；未核实个人工具资格与费用。

research_publication.en: GenAI outputs used for essential information, decisions or research must be independently verified. Publication and thesis-specific disclosure rules remain a gap.
research_publication.zh: 用于重要信息、决策或研究的生成式 AI 输出须独立核实；发表及学位论文专属披露规则仍有缺口。
research_publication.meaningEn: Reliance on outputs, including research; not blanket approval of any research use.
research_publication.meaningZh: 适用于依赖输出的情形，包括科研；不代表所有科研用途均获批准。

academic_integrity.en: Unauthorised GenAI concerns follow the academic-misconduct procedures. Poor-practice outcomes can involve discretion; full current appeal deadlines remain unverified.
academic_integrity.zh: 未经许可使用生成式 AI 的疑虑须按学术不端程序处理；不良学术规范问题的处理可有裁量，当前完整申诉期限仍待核实。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: Policy effective from September 2025, with minor revisions recorded in June 2026; do not infer an automatic penalty from an allegation.
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 政策自 2025 年 9 月实施，2026 年 6 月记有小幅修订；不能因出现指控就推断自动处罚。

teaching_guidance.en: The module coordinator, programme lead or Head of Department sets legitimate AI-use limits in module or programme design.
teaching_guidance.zh: 模块协调人、项目负责人或系主任确定课程或项目设计中的合理 AI 使用范围。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: Role-specific educational design and assessment guidance.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 限对应教学设计和考核职责。

security_procurement.en: Cloud-based tools must pass UL Cloud Governance approval, alongside the university’s existing security and use policies.
security_procurement.zh: 涉及云服务的工具须通过 UL 云治理审批，并遵守既有安全与使用政策。
security_procurement.meaningEn: Cloud governance; course permission and personal access still require separate checks.
security_procurement.meaningZh: 云治理范围；课程许可和个人访问仍须另查。

scope.en: Use the source-specific audience, assessment and publication limits below. Institution-wide policy review remains PARTIAL.
scope.zh: 请按下列来源的对象、考核及发表范围使用信息，整校政策审核仍为 PARTIAL。

do.en: Follow the AI-use level communicated by your module leader.
do.zh: 遵守模块负责人公布的 AI 使用范围。

dont.en: Do not go beyond the module or programme specifications for assessed GenAI use.
dont.zh: 考核中不得超出模块或项目公布的生成式 AI 使用规定。

Microsoft Copilot.description: 若使用生成式 AI，UL 当前偏好师生通过大学账户使用 Microsoft Copilot；个人开通与考核许可须分别确认。
Microsoft Copilot.howToObtain: 偏好平台指引；未核实个人工具资格与费用。 若使用生成式 AI，UL 当前偏好师生通过大学账户使用 Microsoft Copilot；个人开通与考核许可须分别确认。
Microsoft Copilot.costToUser: 尚未独立核实具体账户及使用模式的费用条件。
